content.text: This is version 13.1-systemd of the Linux From Scratch book, dated September 1st, 2026. If this book is more than six months old, a newer and better version is probably already available. To find out, please check one of the mirrors via
Below is a list of changes made since the previous release of the book.
[bdubbs] - Add tar-1.35-acl_fix-1.patch. Addresses issue arising from acl-2.4.0.
[bdubbs] - Add Python3-3.14.6 consolidated fixes (Security patch). Fixes
[xry111] - Fix CVE-2026-4046, CVE-2026-5450, and CVE-2026-5928 in glibc (Security Update). Fixes
[renodr] - Fix CVE-2026-7210 and CVE-2026-8328 in Python (Security Update). Fixes
[bdubbs] - Add Python-3.14.5 linux7 build patch. Addresses
[bdubbs] - Add systemd openssl4 build patch. Addresses
[jlocash] - Update the Python-3.14.4 patch for 2 more issues (Security update). Addresses
[bdubbs] - Move intltool and XML-Parser to BLFS. Fixes
[bdubbs] - Add a sed to glibc-2.43 (Security update). Fixes
[bdubbs] - Add a patch to Python-3.14.3 (Security update). Fixes
